questions.q: The BECE syllabus highlights the shared origins of Christianity and Islam as a basis for peaceful co-existence. The two religions trace their physical and spiritual lineage back to Abraham through which two sons? (Genesis 16, 21)
questions.explain: Judaism and Christianity trace their covenant lineage through Abraham and Sarah's son, Isaac, while Islam traces its origins back through Abraham and Hagar's son, Ishmael. Acknowledging Abraham as a common father fosters mutual respect.

questions.q: In Genesis 13:8, a dispute arose over grazing land between the herdsmen of Abram (Abraham) and his nephew. What was the nephew's name, to whom Abram proposed peaceful co-existence by allowing him to choose land first?
questions.explain: Abram modeled peaceful co-existence, saying to Lot: "Let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen, for we are kinsmen. Is not the whole land before you?"
